title: ConfigMap and Secret ValueFrom Injection
content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app-config
data:
  APP_ENV: development
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: app-secret
stringData:
  APP_SECRET: replace-me
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        env:
        - name: APP_ENV
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: app-config
              key: APP_ENV
        - name: APP_SECRET
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: app-secret
              key: APP_SECRET
